text: No, this rural asset has not shown any signs of recent fire activity. According to NASA’s fire detection systems (VIIRS and MODIS), there were zero thermal anomalies within the property between October 4 and November 3, 2026. The sensors had full coverage of the area during this period. However, very small, short-lived, or low-intensity fires—especially those obscured by clouds—might not have been detected. This evidence alone doesn’t confirm the absence of burned areas or rule out other causes of land changes, such as harvesting or clearing.
